items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I recall you saying somewhere that Benny Goodman was your first idol. Well, I was very moved by his band and his clarinet playing... that was the reason I asked for a clarinet, because of his inspiration.

ctx.x: How did you like his playing?
I thought it was very nice, nothing special. After hearing Benny Goodman and all that, it was just kind of mediocre, I guess.
I heard somewhere that Mulligan wanted to hire him for the Birth of the Cool band.
